written_by: weekly-plan skill (sonnet), via bops:weekly, mid-week catch-up, 16 days since week_of 2026-09-26

readiness.summary: C5, C6 and B6 closed on 2026-10-12: the QA walk passed, the website download copy merged (PR #45), and v0.1.0 was cut, tagged and published as a pre-release with eight assets and a GPG-signed manifest. Build case moves from first to next. One blocker stands: B7, the clean-Mac acceptance test of the published Release, which has not been run. latest_main_run is success on the measured SHA, zero pull requests are open, and the applied ruleset matches the committed copy.

items.title: Walk signing-runbook A8 on a clean Mac
acceptance: the DMG downloaded from the Release URL on a machine that has never had the project opens with no Gatekeeper warning of any kind; the Windows and Linux assets extract and launch on a clean machine; recorded in a daily log
the Windows and Linux binaries from the Release report 0.1.0 (the 2026-10-12 log checked the Mac app only)
SHA256SUMS.txt downloaded from the Release verifies against SHA256SUMS.txt.asc with the published GPG key, and shasum -a 256 -c is OK on the downloaded files
items.context: B6 is done: v0.1.0 was cut and published as a pre-release on 2026-10-12 (tag v0.1.0 at d023ef7, eight assets). B7 is the acceptance test the release has not had: the rebuilt .dmg is an APFS image where Godot's was HFS+, and it has only been mounted on the Mac that built it. The two extra criteria are the checks the 2026-10-12 log says were not recorded.
references: obsidian-vault/daily-logs/2026-10-12.md (Also this session: B6, Open questions)

items.title: Decide what the next build contains after v0.1.0
acceptance: a Decision logged block in docs/roadmap.md or a daily log names the next build's scope: Phase 2 completion (in-map segment renderer and hover highlight, deferred post-v0.1.0 on 2026-08-06) or Phase 3 (economy and information), or something else
the first work items for that scope are named so the next weekly plan can route them
items.context: The build case is now next, and week.json holds no feature work. Roadmap Phase 2 completion lists the segment renderer and hover highlight as deferred post-v0.1.0, and Phase 3 exit criteria name economy_manager_test.gd and information_manager_test.gd, which do not exist. Which one the next build targets is the product owner's call, not the planner's. This item is the planner's inference from the roadmap, not something a log asks for.

items.title: Decide whether D4 is still wanted
acceptance: D4 is kept as written, rewritten, or dropped, with the reason in a daily log
items.context: PR #47 (2026-10-09) committed game/project.godot in Godot's comment-free form, and docs/project-godot-settings.md now records each setting's rationale and says not to add comments to the file. That addresses the 2026-09-25 incident D4 documents. The 2026-10-12 log leaves the call to Brent.

items.title: Exercise the dco job on a deliberately unsigned commit
acceptance: the dco job observed red on a throwaway pull request with an unsigned commit, green once signed off; the pull request closed without merging; recorded in a daily log
items.context: The ruleset has now refused a merge once (Tool tests, PR #12); dco itself has never been red. Fifteen minutes with gh, and it proves the gate that ADR 0019 and 0020 rest on.

items.title: Make every P0 row in docs/test-plan.md §11 name a test or a deferral
acceptance: every P0 row in docs/test-plan.md §11 either names a test that exists in game/tests/ (checked against docs/plan/facts.json game.tests) or is marked deferred with a reason
the note-level figure the reviews quote (named / missing / percent) is recomputed from the edited table and stated in the commit body
items.context: The 09-01 and 09-08 reviews disagreed about this table's figures. Closing the rows removes the figure from the reviews altogether.

items.title: Name a test for the two minigame scripts or exempt them
acceptance: python3 tools/facts.py reports game.scripts_without_named_test as an empty list, either because snowpack_minigame_test.gd and telemetry_minigame_test.gd exist and run green, or because the script is added to TEST_EXEMPT_SCRIPTS in tools/facts.py with a one-line reason
if tests were added, the stated suite figure in docs/testing-setup.md is updated and python3 tools/suite_figures.py --check passes
a commit plan on branch verify/v12-... claims every changed path
items.context: facts.json reports snowpack_minigame and telemetry_minigame as scripts with no named test. The exempt list in tools/facts.py exists so this figure means something, and these two are not on it. Their solver and profile logic is already covered by snowpack_profile_test and telemetry_solver_test, so the choice is a test for the UI scripts or a stated exemption.

items.title: Fix signing-runbook.md Part D point 3's stale Build-review V2 reference
acceptance: Part D point 3's "Build-review V2 is still open" line is corrected or removed. The pack gate already covers Windows and, before 2026-09-26, covered macOS too, via ci.yml's Verify-every-exported-pack's-contents loop.
no other line in Part D changes
items.context: Flagged 2026-09-25 while fixing ci.yml's macOS export: point 3 still describes an open build-review item that looks closed elsewhere in the repo. A stated-line correction, the haiku case in docs/plan/routing.md.

items.title: Retire or rewrite docs/pre-build-checklist.md
acceptance: docs/pre-build-checklist.md no longer asserts there is no Godot project to build: either its status is archived with a one-paragraph pointer to docs/plan/week.json and the build reviews as the living punch list, or its checklist is rewritten against docs/plan/facts.json
any README or docs link to it still resolves and describes what it now is
a commit plan on branch docs/d1-… claims every changed path
items.context: Flagged in eight consecutive reviews and never fixed, because §4 rows had no mechanism to close. The repository is public, so the file is stranger-facing. Judgment about what the document should become, so Cowork.

items.title: Document a safeguard against game/project.godot losing its comments
acceptance: game/CLAUDE.md states that opening the project in the Godot editor can silently strip project.godot's comments on save, and instructs running git diff -- game/project.godot before staging any commit that touched the editor
the note names the 2026-09-25 incident (comments lost, caught, reverted before commit) as the reason
items.context: Caught live 2026-09-25 while landing C1: project.godot lost every comment mid-session, most likely from the editor resaving it, and was reverted before it landed in any commit. No regeneration fix is known; a documented pre-commit check is the cheap mitigation until one is. PR #47 has since committed project.godot comment-free and docs/project-godot-settings.md records why; Q2 decides whether this item is still wanted.

items.title: Decide whether HUD and credits text size earns an item
acceptance: either an item is added (font size or larger default window) or the text is declared fine at 1280x720, with the reason in a daily log
items.context: C5 passed on 2026-10-12: HUD message line, HUD lines and credits screen were small but legible at 1280x720 with canvas_items stretch. The log says it is not tracked anywhere yet and Brent decides whether it earns an item.
